title: Vivo Exporter

fields.name: empty_stream_on_read
fields.description: If enabled, when an HTTP client consumes the data from a stream, the stream content will be removed.

fields.name: host
fields.description: The network address for the HTTP server to listen on.

fields.name: http_cors_allow_origin
fields.description: Specify the value for the HTTP Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (CORS).

fields.name: port
fields.description: The TCP port for the HTTP server to listen on.

fields.name: stream_queue_size
fields.description: Specify the maximum queue size per stream. Each specific stream for logs, metrics, and traces can hold up to stream_queue_size bytes.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
